text:
Talia Benson: Heads up: we’re rolling out the new **Sales Demo Environment (“demo tenant”)** + standard talk track/deck starting next week.

Goal: same demo every time (fast setup, stable model pins, dashboards not empty, clear backup paths). Please route demo requests through the new materials + certify before running external demos.

Start here (Confluence hub): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Sales+Demo+Environment

Key links:
- Demo deck (canonical): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Pitch+Decks+-+Redwood+Demo+Deck+v1
- Talk track script (tied to deck): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Demo+Talk+Track+Script+v1
- Demo personas + scenarios: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Demo+Personas+and+Scenarios
- Reset runbook (SEs): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENGPLAT/Demo+Tenant+Reset+Runbook
- Provisioning overview (what’s what): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENGPLAT/Demo+Tenant+Provisioning+Overview
- Training + certification rubric: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DemoTrainingAgendaCert/view

Please do *not* use customer data in the demo tenant (everything is synthetic) and don’t share keys over email/Slack. More details in the access policy doc linked from the hub.

Stephanie Nguyen: +1. Starting **Monday**, new external demos should use the v1 deck + talk track unless you get an explicit exception from Markus/SE leadership. We’ve had too many one-off flows + breakages.

Markus Klein: SE note: the demo tenant is production-like but has safety rails. If you’re running a live demo, do a quick preflight first (healthcheck + make sure dashboards have traffic). Runbook has a 3–5 min checklist.

Elliot Price: If you’re short on time, there’s also an “Exec 20” path called out in the speaker notes (what to skip + safe screenshots vs live clicking). Same talk track link Talia posted.

Soojin Lee: Also: please stick to the approved phrasing on Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private (we got feedback that folks were mixing SKUs). Slide notes include the exact one-liner.

Alex Martinez: DevEx: demo code snippets are pinned for stability. If you’re using the demo app, don’t `pip install -U` / `npm update` right before a call :) We’ll publish the pinned versions in the hub.

Sean Gallagher: SRE angle: demo env has its own SLOs + alerting. If you hit a live issue (429s, streaming disconnects, empty dashboards), drop details in #sales-demo-help and include the healthcheck output. We have an escalation path now.

Naomi Feldman: Security reminder: it’s OK to show *synthetic* audit log entries + screenshots, but avoid drilling into raw request/response payloads on screenshare unless you’re sure it’s the demo project + synthetic traffic. When in doubt, use “backup mode” screenshots.

Redwood Confluence Bot: Page updated: “Sales Demo Environment” https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Sales+Demo+Environment (Updated by Talia Benson)

Markus Klein: For access: don’t DM for keys. Use the request flow linked in the hub (RBAC + scoped keys + rotation). If you’re blocked, file an internal support ticket and tag me.

Stephanie Nguyen: Training sessions are on the calendar this week (2 time slots). Certification is required for AEs/SEs before end of month.

Talia Benson: FAQ: yes, we support **parallel demos** via isolated projects/keys; please follow the naming convention so dashboards look right + we don’t cross-contaminate.

Elliot Price: I’m collecting feedback on the deck/talk track after your first 2 runs—drop comments in the Confluence page or DM me. We’ll cut a v1.1 once the dust settles.
